name: Item Soft-Delete and Recovery - REST APIs
description: Item soft-delete and recovery offer a secure and efficient way to manage deleted items. When an item is deleted, it is moved to the *recoverable items* and retained for a defined retention period.  Users will be able to configure the retention period during which the items are retained.During this retention period, users can restore items or permanently remove them through REST API.

result.nameEs: Eliminación temporal y recuperación de elementos: API REST
